label: Diagnose — Symptom Walkthrough
description: Conversational symptom-driven diagnosis. Walks the user through observation, measurement, and isolation steps using the diagnostic case layer of the active HKP. Produces a Reasoning Trail, a candidate root cause, and a remediation plan; offers to contribute the case back to the community on resolution.

claudeKnowledge.description: ESP32 community knowledge, Espressif advisories, diagnostic case patterns
